input.command:
python3 -c "
import glob, cv2, numpy as np
# Let's inspect the color of the blue object in obs 32
img32 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0032.png')
# let's look at pixel at (393, 400)
print('obs 32 color at (393, 400):', img32[400, 393])

target_bgr = img32[400, 393]
for path in sorted(glob.glob('/work/observations/obs_*.png')):
    img = cv2.imread(path)
    diff = np.linalg.norm(img.astype(float) - target_bgr.astype(float), axis=2)
    cnt = np.sum(diff < 30)
    if cnt > 50:
        vs, us = np.where(diff < 30)
        print(f'{path[-12:]}: count={cnt}, u in [{us.min()}, {us.max()}], v in [{vs.min()}, {vs.max()}]')
"
input.description: Find blue object in all observations by color matching
